objective: Give the frontend bucket a deployment path. StorageStack creates frontendBucket and CdnStack serves it through CloudFront, but nothing ever uploads anything to it, so a deploy produces an empty site. Add a BucketDeployment of the built frontend to CdnStack, gated behind a deployFrontend context flag that defaults off, so credential-free synth in CI is unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: With context deployFrontend unset, the synthesized Fanwire-Cdn template contains no Custom::CDKBucketDeployment resource, and all three domain modes still synthesize with no missing context and no error annotations.
With context deployFrontend set to true, the synthesized Fanwire-Cdn template contains exactly one Custom::CDKBucketDeployment resource.
That deployment targets the frontend bucket, not the public-media bucket.
That deployment sets a CloudFront invalidation on the distribution for path /* so a redeploy is visible rather than cached.
loadConfig exposes the flag as a typed boolean on FanwireConfig, defaulting to false when the context key is absent.
With deployFrontend true, the IAM wildcard gate still passes in all three domain modes, or any new wildcard is added to ALLOW_LIST with a written reason.
